summary: 11 of 16 pass, 5 fail; no fabricated quotes. Every evidence quote is on its page. Two line numbers are off by three (2D Torus is :58, not :55; Floquet is :276, not :273), and the text is right in both. The FM cluster is sound. Five established pages talk about FM in sentences written before it had a page, and each FM link has its reason in prose, as do the Splice Forge sampler link, Substrate Skill's harness fact, the two CAD Drafter links and both weak-link fixes. The failures share one pattern: the reader built a relation from a resemblance or a wish that neither page states. Drift and Consolidation has only a shape-likeness to Operator Memory, and the real fold of memory into canon sits on Weaving Memory into the Palace. Review Layer mentions memory once in passing. Lettering's request for a legibility judge, and the Gallery's scans, both point at an OCR that has only been tested on clean digital renders. The Gallery-to-Cycle 5 link skips the work page that should carry it. So two newcomers stay low for honest reasons. LightOnOCR-3 gains nothing until a probe proves it reads letterforms or scans, and Cycle 5 Explorer gains only through its FOUR PILLARS retype. One label passes with a better one offered: Image-to-3D Smith against CAD Drafter reads organic-vs-fitted on CAD Drafter's own page.
